description: Per-merchant clicks / impressions / spend / CTR / CPC / CPM for a marketplace over a period, grouped by merchant (os_client_id + merchant name). Spend is converted to the marketplace currency; CTR (%), CPC and CPM are computed per merchant. Filter by channel to isolate PLA (os_product_ads) vs Display (guaranteed_display_ads / auction_display_ads).

os_client_id.description: OnlineSales client id of the merchant (working id for internal analysis).

merchant_id.description: Merchant (seller) id (working id for internal analysis).

channel.description: Ad program channel: os_product_ads (PLA), guaranteed_display_ads / auction_display_ads (Display). Use as a filter to scope the breakdown to a program type.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend for this merchant, converted to the marketplace currency.

ctr.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.clicks ELSE 0 END) * 100.0, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)), 2), 0)
ctr.description: Click-through rate (%) = clicks / impressions * 100 for this merchant.

cpc.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)), 4), 0)
cpc.description: Cost per click = spend / clicks for this merchant, in the marketplace currency.

cpm.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END) * 1000, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)), 4), 0)
cpm.description: Cost per mille = spend / impressions * 1000 for this merchant, in the marketplace currency.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.client_vendor_channel_performance_facts` AS cvcpf INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS clients ON clients.client_id = cvcpf.client_id AND clients.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mc.agency_id = clients.agency_id AND clients.client_id != mc.marketplace_client_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.monetize_merchant_dimensions` AS mmd ON mmd.merchant_id = clients.seller_id AND mmd.agency_id = clients.agency_id LEFT JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = cvcpf.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE cvcpf.vendor = 'os_ads' AND cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
